text.content: FastWAM GAU0 step-5000 PlaceFood same-panel closed-loop eval

Objective: evaluate the archived FastWAM GAU0 step-5000 checkpoint on the exact GAU1 PlaceFood-rf eight-episode panel and compare closed-loop outcomes under the same evaluator contract. Hypothesis: removing compact Gaussian conditioning may change closed-loop PlaceFood performance relative to the GAU1 0/8 baseline while panel, seeds, action decoding, and evaluator settings remain fixed.

Priority=7; exactly one DLC job; GAU0 model config enable_gaussian=false; no Gaussian teacher construction; agent_gaussian=None; exact historical panel indices 0-7, policy seeds 10000-10007, environment seeds 333183/333327/333225/333180/333251/333130/333167/333234; eight terminal episode records; infrastructure errors separated from task failures; compare against GAU1 0/8 and disclose normalization provenance difference.

PlaceFood-rf N=2; action horizon=32; exec horizon=5; max steps=300; diffusion inference steps=20; checkpoint step=5000; FastWAM GAU0; video/action joint checkpoint architecture; hub enabled; Gaussian disabled.

Exact historical GAU1 panel /mnt/workspace/fastwam_eval_runtime/panels/robofactory_n234_s42_val8_v1.json; primary comparison uses exact historical GAU1 evaluator normalization /mnt/workspace/fastwam_eval_runtime/inputs/dataset_stats.step5000.92dfdeec.json. GAU0 training-native 3226-byte stats differ from the 2828-byte evaluator stats and are a declared sensitivity factor.
Alibaba PAI DLC cn-beijing, workspace 270969, resource quota quotaksvqq2oh2pg; immutable source snapshot and OSS outputs required; image and direct-byte inventory pending preflight.

Primary matched comparison: GAU0 versus historical GAU1 under the same eight PlaceFood-rf episodes, environment seeds, policy seeds, execution horizon, diffusion steps, and evaluator normalization. This is not an isolated causal Gaussian ablation because checkpoint training lineage and trainable scope differ. A second GAU0 arm using training-native normalization is reported only as sensitivity analysis.

Submission gate: code tests pass; no-Gaussian branch proves teacher construction is skipped and agent_gaussian=None; checkpoint, panel, stats, simulator, context, source snapshot, output absence, capacity, exact candidate count, and Priority=7 are all re-read immediately before the one-shot submit.
